---
title: "Plot existing GFM simulation results"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    code_folding: hide
    self_contained: true
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    keep_tex: true
    latex_engine: xelatex
    fig_crop: false
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
params:
  data_dir: "../data/node1"
  output_dir: "../data/figures"
  all_nodes_file: null
  sample_sizes: null
  main_n: null
  max_columns: 4
---

This document reads existing simulation results. It does not simulate networks,
fit models, or repeat Monte Carlo experiments. Open it in RStudio and **Knit to
HTML** (the default), or choose **Knit to PDF** from the Knit menu. Plotting
uses base R; knitting requires `rmarkdown` and `knitr`, and PDF output also needs
a LaTeX installation providing XeLaTeX. The PDF report hides source code and
embeds vector PDF figures. The HTML report retains expandable code and PNG previews.
Paths are relative to this document, in the repository's `plots` directory.

Put the native `*_results.csv` and matching `*_config.rds` files under `data_dir`.
Subdirectories are searched automatically; a single pair is sufficient. Keep
different runs in separate directories: duplicate cases or incompatible seeds
produce an error instead of silently combining results. `sample_sizes` optionally
selects sample sizes; `main_n: null` selects the largest available sample size
within each $K$ and $\Lambda$ group.
Change `output_dir` for each collection if you want to preserve earlier figures.

For optional all-node plots, set `all_nodes_file` to a native
`component_summary.csv`, its run directory, or a YAML list of such paths. Each
summary must retain its adjacent `config.rds`. Leave it `null` to produce the
nodewise QQ plots alone. The older, aggregated plotting CSV without configuration
files is not the input format of this portable document.
When a native run directory contains both aggregate and per-case summaries,
the per-case files and their matching configurations are used.

## 1. Read and check the saved results

Theorem 1 has $K$ coordinates and Theorem 2 has $P=K(K+1)/2$ coordinates.
Coordinates are plotted separately. The CSV columns `raw_lambda_*` and
`debiased_lambda_*` contain **standardized estimation errors**, not parameter
estimates. A row is retained only when its fit converged and every plotted
standardized component and joint statistic is finite. The same retained rows
are used for all nodewise plots of that case. The tables below disclose exclusions;
they can affect how the diagnostic plots should be interpreted.

```{r setup, echo=knitr::is_html_output(), results='asis'}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = knitr::is_html_output(), message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)

# HTML keeps full tables; PDF uses compact tables that can continue across pages.
report_table <- function(d, caption = NULL, align = NULL, new_page = FALSE) {
  cat("\n\n")
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    if (new_page && nrow(d) > 12L) cat("\\clearpage\n")
    table_text <- as.character(knitr::kable(
      d, format = "latex", longtable = TRUE, booktabs = TRUE,
      row.names = FALSE, caption = caption, align = align, escape = TRUE,
      label = if (is.null(caption)) NA else paste0("plot-", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(caption)))))
    # Retain column headings if a larger collection spans several pages.
    heading <- strsplit(strsplit(table_text, "\\toprule\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][2],
                        "\\midrule\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
    table_text <- sub("\\midrule\n", paste0("\\midrule\n\\endfirsthead\n\\toprule\n",
                       heading, "\\midrule\n\\endhead\n"), table_text, fixed = TRUE)
    cat(table_text)
  } else {
    print(knitr::kable(d, row.names = FALSE, caption = caption))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
# Escape caption text once, character by character, including literal underscores.
latex_escape <- function(x) {
  replacements <- c("\\" = "\\textbackslash{}", "{" = "\\{", "}" = "\\}",
                    "$" = "\\$", "&" = "\\&", "%" = "\\%", "#" = "\\#",
                    "_" = "\\_", "~" = "\\textasciitilde{}", "^" = "\\textasciicircum{}")
  vapply(strsplit(as.character(x), "", fixed = TRUE), function(chars) {
    matched <- match(chars, names(replacements))
    chars[!is.na(matched)] <- replacements[matched[!is.na(matched)]]
    paste0(chars, collapse = "")
  }, character(1))
}
data_dir <- params$data_dir
figure_dir <- params$output_dir
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
max_columns <- as.integer(params$max_columns)
if (length(max_columns) != 1L || is.na(max_columns) || max_columns < 1L ||
    max_columns != params$max_columns) stop("max_columns must be a positive integer.")
model_names <- c(gaussian = "Gaussian", poisson = "Poisson",
                 logit = "Logit", probit = "Probit")
blue <- "#176B98"; raw_gray <- "#8B9298"; ink <- "#253746"
axis_gray <- "#6B7379"; point_size <- 0.36

# Canonical names allow both native Bernoulli names and short model names.
model_name <- function(x) sub("^bernoulli_", "", x)
numbered_cols <- function(d, stem) {
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", stem, "[0-9]+$"), names(d), value = TRUE)
  cols[order(as.integer(sub(stem, "", cols, fixed = TRUE)))]
}
lambda_key <- function(x) paste(sprintf("%.17g", x), collapse = ",")
lambda_label <- function(x) paste0("Lambda = (", paste(format(x, trim = TRUE, digits = 10), collapse = ", "), ")")

# Configuration metadata, rather than filename fragments, identifies each case.
read_config <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing configuration file: ", path)
  cfg <- readRDS(path)
  required <- c("model", "n", "k", "n_sim", "lambda_vec", "target_node",
                "design_seed", "replication_seed_base", "truth_design")
  if (!is.list(cfg) || !all(required %in% names(cfg)))
    stop("Configuration lacks required metadata: ", path)
  for (field in c("n", "k", "n_sim", "target_node", "design_seed", "replication_seed_base")) {
    value <- cfg[[field]]
    if (!is.numeric(value) || length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) ||
        value != as.integer(value)) stop("Invalid ", field, " in ", path)
  }
  if (cfg$n < 2L || cfg$k < 1L || cfg$n_sim < 1L || cfg$target_node < 1L ||
      cfg$target_node > cfg$n || !is.numeric(cfg$lambda_vec) ||
      length(cfg$lambda_vec) != cfg$k || any(!is.finite(cfg$lambda_vec)))
    stop("Invalid dimensions or Lambda in ", path)
  cfg$model <- model_name(cfg$model)
  if (length(cfg$model) != 1L || !cfg$model %in% names(model_names) ||
      length(cfg$truth_design) != 1L || is.na(cfg$truth_design))
    stop("Invalid model or design metadata: ", path)
  cfg
}
case_key <- function(cfg) paste(cfg$model, cfg$n, cfg$k, lambda_key(cfg$lambda_vec), sep = "|")
design_key <- function(cfg) paste(cfg$design_seed, cfg$replication_seed_base,
                                 cfg$target_node, cfg$truth_design, sep = "|")
group_key <- function(cfg) paste(cfg$k, lambda_key(cfg$lambda_vec), sep = "|")

read_case <- function(path) {
  cfg <- read_config(sub("_results[.]csv$", "_config.rds", path))
  d <- read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)
  K <- cfg$k; P <- K * (K + 1L) / 2L
  stems <- c("stat_U_", "raw_lambda_", "debiased_lambda_")
  counts <- c(K, P, P)
  for (j in seq_along(stems)) {
    if (!identical(numbered_cols(d, stems[j]), paste0(stems[j], seq_len(counts[j]))))
      stop("Component columns disagree with K in ", path)
  }
  columns <- c(paste0("stat_U_", seq_len(K)), paste0("raw_lambda_", seq_len(P)),
               paste0("debiased_lambda_", seq_len(P)), "chi_sq_U", "chi_sq_debiased_lambda")
  if (!all(c(columns, "convergence_code") %in% names(d)) || !nrow(d))
    stop("Missing statistics or empty results in ", path)
  # read.csv represents an entirely NA column as logical when every fit failed.
  for (column in columns) if (is.logical(d[[column]]) && all(is.na(d[[column]])))
    d[[column]] <- as.numeric(d[[column]])
  if (!all(vapply(d[columns], is.numeric, logical(1))))
    stop("Missing or nonnumeric statistics in ", path)
  converged <- !is.na(d$convergence_code) & d$convergence_code == 0L
  finite <- rowSums(!is.finite(as.matrix(d[columns]))) == 0L
  keep <- converged & finite
  used <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  # Preserve the joint statistics in the CSV, but verify their definitions.
  if (nrow(used)) {
    for (pair in list(c("chi_sq_U", "stat_U_"), c("chi_sq_debiased_lambda", "debiased_lambda_"))) {
      sums <- rowSums(used[numbered_cols(used, pair[2])]^2)
      if (any(abs(used[[pair[1]]] - sums) > 1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(sums))))
        stop("Joint statistic disagrees with component squared norms in ", path)
    }
  }
  used$chi_sq_raw_lambda <- rowSums(used[paste0("raw_lambda_", seq_len(P))]^2)
  list(config = cfg, data = used, path = normalizePath(path),
       attempted = nrow(d), converged = sum(converged), used = sum(keep),
       selection = data.frame(row = seq_len(nrow(d)), converged = converged,
                              finite = finite, included = keep))
}

paths <- sort(list.files(data_dir, pattern = "_results[.]csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
if (!length(paths)) stop("No *_results.csv files found in data_dir. Run a simulation first, or point data_dir to existing native results.")
cases <- lapply(paths, read_case)
if (!is.null(params$sample_sizes)) {
  sample_sizes <- as.numeric(unlist(params$sample_sizes))
  if (!length(sample_sizes) || any(!is.finite(sample_sizes)) ||
      any(sample_sizes < 2 | sample_sizes != as.integer(sample_sizes)))
    stop("sample_sizes must contain integer sample sizes of at least 2.")
  cases <- Filter(function(x) x$config$n %in% sample_sizes, cases)
}
if (!length(cases)) stop("No results match sample_sizes.")
keys <- vapply(cases, function(x) case_key(x$config), character(1))
if (anyDuplicated(keys)) stop("Duplicate model/n/Lambda cases found. Set data_dir to one selected run; duplicate key: ", keys[duplicated(keys)][1])
if (length(unique(vapply(cases, function(x) design_key(x$config), character(1)))) != 1L)
  stop("Results have different design seeds, replication seeds, target nodes, or truth designs. Select one coherent run collection.")
names(cases) <- keys
available_n <- sort(unique(vapply(cases, function(x) x$config$n, numeric(1))))
main_n <- if (is.null(params$main_n)) max(available_n) else params$main_n
if (length(main_n) != 1L || !is.numeric(main_n) || !main_n %in% available_n)
  stop("main_n must be one of the available sample sizes: ", paste(available_n, collapse = ", "))
input_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cases, function(x) data.frame(
  model = x$config$model, n = x$config$n, K = x$config$k,
  lambda = lambda_key(x$config$lambda_vec), target_node = x$config$target_node,
  design_seed = x$config$design_seed, replication_seed_base = x$config$replication_seed_base,
  planned = x$config$n_sim, attempted = x$attempted, converged = x$converged,
  used = x$used, excluded = x$attempted - x$used, csv = x$path)))
row_selection <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cases, function(x) cbind(csv = x$path, x$selection)))
write.csv(input_table, file.path(figure_dir, "plot_inputs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(row_selection, file.path(figure_dir, "row_selection.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  case_ids <- sprintf("C%02d", seq_len(nrow(input_table)))
  common <- cases[[1]]$config
  cat(sprintf("All cases use design seed **%s**, replication seed base **%s**, and target node **%s**.\n\n",
              common$design_seed, common$replication_seed_base, common$target_node))
  cat("Case IDs follow the row order in `plot_inputs.csv`; full metadata and file paths remain in that CSV.\n\n")
  metadata <- data.frame(Case = case_ids, Model = unname(model_names[input_table$model]),
                         n = input_table$n, K = input_table$K,
                         Lambda = vapply(cases, function(x) sub("^Lambda = ", "", lambda_label(x$config$lambda_vec)), character(1)))
  report_table(metadata, "Simulation cases", align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "p{0.32\\linewidth}"), new_page = TRUE)
  counts <- input_table[c("planned", "attempted", "converged", "used", "excluded")]
  names(counts) <- c("Planned", "Attempted", "Converged", "Used", "Excluded")
  report_table(cbind(Case = case_ids, counts), "Replication counts", new_page = TRUE)
} else {
  report_table(input_table[setdiff(names(input_table), "csv")])
}
if (any(input_table$excluded > 0L)) warning("Some replications were excluded. See the table and row_selection.csv; plots describe the retained replications.")
if (any(input_table$planned != input_table$attempted)) warning("Saved row counts differ from planned repetitions for some cases. See plot_inputs.csv.")
```

`used` counts successful fits with finite values for all displayed statistics.
Cases with fewer than two retained replications are marked unavailable in their
panels. Changing this plot document cannot repair failed fits. An input log and
the inclusion decision for every original CSV row are saved beside the figures.

## 2. Plotting functions

For $R$ retained replications, the theoretical quantiles use
$p_r=(r-1/2)/R$. Normal QQ plots use $\Phi^{-1}(p_r)$; joint QQ plots use
$F^{-1}_{\chi^2_d}(p_r)$, with $d=K$ or $P$. Each retained replication appears
as one open circle. The dashed line is $y=x$; no reference band is added and
the saved statistics are never recentered or rescaled.

```{r plotting-functions}
theoretical <- function(R, df = NULL) {
  p <- (seq_len(R) - 0.5) / R
  if (is.null(df)) qnorm(p) else qchisq(p, df)
}
safe_range <- function(x, zero = FALSE) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) x <- if (zero) c(0, 1) else c(-3, 3)
  r <- range(x); pad <- max(diff(r) * 0.045, 0.12)
  if (zero) c(0, max(r[2], 0) + pad) else r + c(-pad, pad)
}
pages <- function(values) split(values, ceiling(seq_along(values) / max_columns))
ordered_models <- function(collection) {
  names(model_names)[names(model_names) %in% vapply(collection, function(x) x$config$model, character(1))]
}
get_case <- function(collection, model, n) {
  hit <- Filter(function(x) x$config$model == model && x$config$n == n, collection)
  if (length(hit)) hit[[1]] else NULL
}
# Matched panels share limits across the available sample sizes for one model.
qq_limits <- function(collection, model, columns, df = NULL) {
  selected <- Filter(function(x) x$config$model == model && x$used >= 2L, collection)
  theoretical_values <- unlist(lapply(selected, function(x) theoretical(x$used, df)))
  empirical_values <- unlist(lapply(selected, function(x) as.matrix(x$data[columns])))
  list(x = safe_range(theoretical_values, !is.null(df)),
       y = safe_range(c(theoretical_values, empirical_values), !is.null(df)))
}
start_grid <- function(nr, nc, top_labels, row_labels,
                       xlab = "Standard normal quantiles", ylab = "Empirical quantiles",
                       legend_labels = NULL) {
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0), las = 1,
      xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i", col.axis = ink, col.lab = ink, fg = ink)
  width <- par("din")[1]; height <- par("din")[2]
  top <- if (is.null(legend_labels)) 0.54 else 0.91
  list(nr = nr, nc = nc, width = width, height = height, top = top,
       left = 0.87, bottom = 0.56, gapx = 0.43, gapy = 0.30,
       pw = (width - 1.02 - (nc - 1L) * 0.43) / nc,
       ph = (height - 0.56 - top - (nr - 1L) * 0.30) / nr,
       top_labels = top_labels, row_labels = row_labels, xlab = xlab, ylab = ylab,
       legend_labels = legend_labels)
}
open_panel <- function(g, row, column) {
  x <- g$left + (column - 1L) * (g$pw + g$gapx)
  y <- g$bottom + (g$nr - row) * (g$ph + g$gapy)
  par(fig = c(x, x + g$pw, y, y + g$ph) / c(g$width, g$width, g$height, g$height),
      mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), new = !(row == 1L && column == 1L), xpd = FALSE)
  plot.new()
}
finish_grid <- function(g) {
  par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), new = TRUE, xpd = NA)
  plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, g$width), c(0, g$height))
  cx <- g$left + g$pw / 2 + (seq_len(g$nc) - 1) * (g$pw + g$gapx)
  cy <- g$bottom + g$ph / 2 + (g$nr - seq_len(g$nr)) * (g$ph + g$gapy)
  text(cx, g$height - g$top + 0.30, g$top_labels, cex = 0.90, font = 2)
  text(0.35, cy, g$row_labels, srt = 90, cex = 0.92, font = 2)
  text(g$width / 2, 0.13, g$xlab, cex = 0.95)
  text(0.09, g$height / 2, g$ylab, srt = 90, cex = 0.90)
  if (!is.null(g$legend_labels)) legend(g$width / 2, g$height - 0.04,
      legend = g$legend_labels, col = c(raw_gray, blue), pch = 1,
      pt.cex = 0.7, cex = 0.85, horiz = TRUE, bty = "n", xjust = 0.5, yjust = 1)
}
qq_panel <- function(g, row, column, case, limits, columns, df = NULL, colors = blue) {
  open_panel(g, row, column)
  plot.window(limits$x, limits$y)
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, lwd = 0.65, col = "#555E66")
  axis(1, cex.axis = 0.77, mgp = c(0, 0.3, 0), tck = -0.03)
  axis(2, cex.axis = 0.77, mgp = c(0, 0.3, 0), tck = -0.03)
  box(col = "#B2B8BC", lwd = 0.5)
  if (is.null(case) || case$used < 2L) {
    text(mean(limits$x), mean(limits$y), "Unavailable", cex = 0.8)
  } else for (j in seq_along(columns)) {
    points(theoretical(case$used, df), sort(case$data[[columns[j]]]),
           pch = 1, cex = point_size, lwd = 0.52, col = rep(colors, length.out = length(columns))[j])
  }
}

# Save the same drawing twice. PDF reports embed the vector file on its own page.
figure_manifest <- list()
save_figure <- function(name, caption, draw, nr, nc, height = NULL, width = NULL) {
  if (is.null(width)) width <- max(4.0, 1.02 + 1.65 * nc + 0.43 * (nc - 1L))
  if (is.null(height)) height <- max(3.2, 1.1 + 1.45 * nr + 0.30 * (nr - 1L))
  pdf_file <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(name, ".png"))
  pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height, pointsize = 9, useDingbats = FALSE)
  tryCatch(draw(), finally = dev.off())
  png(png_file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 160, pointsize = 9)
  tryCatch(draw(), finally = dev.off())
  figure_manifest[[length(figure_manifest) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
    figure = name, description = caption, pdf = basename(pdf_file), png = basename(png_file))
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    cat("\n\n\\clearpage\n\\begin{figure}[p]\n\\centering\n",
        "\\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth,height=0.78\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{\\detokenize{",
        normalizePath(pdf_file, winslash = "/"), "}}\n",
        "\\caption{", latex_escape(caption), "}\n\\end{figure}\n\\clearpage\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\n![", caption, "](<", normalizePath(png_file), ">)\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
groups <- split(cases, vapply(cases, function(x) group_key(x$config), character(1)))
```

## 3. Nodewise and sample-size QQ plots

Each group fixes $K$ and $\Lambda$. Models occupy rows. Missing model/sample-size
combinations are labelled unavailable; a full grid of simulation runs is not
required. Components or sample sizes beyond `max_columns` continue on another
figure. Raw Theorem 2 results are gray and debiased results are blue. Their
overlay uses identical replications and axes. A shift in the raw curve need
not indicate a failure of the bias-corrected theorem.

```{r qq-figures, results='asis'}
for (group_id in seq_along(groups)) {
  collection <- groups[[group_id]]
  cfg <- collection[[1]]$config
  K <- cfg$k; P <- K * (K + 1L) / 2L
  models <- ordered_models(collection)
  ns <- sort(unique(vapply(collection, function(x) x$config$n, numeric(1))))
  group_main_n <- if (is.null(params$main_n)) max(ns) else main_n
  prefix <- sprintf("group_%02d", group_id)
  label <- paste(lambda_label(cfg$lambda_vec), "node", cfg$target_node, sep = "; ")
  specs <- list(
    theorem1 = list(columns = paste0("stat_U_", seq_len(K)), df = NULL),
    theorem2 = list(columns = paste0("debiased_lambda_", seq_len(P)), df = NULL),
    joint = list(columns = c("chi_sq_U", "chi_sq_raw_lambda", "chi_sq_debiased_lambda"), df = c(K, P, P)))
  if (!group_main_n %in% ns) cat("\n\nMain QQ plots skipped for ", label,
                                 ": requested main_n is unavailable in this group.\n\n", sep = "")
  if (group_main_n %in% ns) for (kind in names(specs)) {
    spec <- specs[[kind]]
    component_pages <- pages(seq_along(spec$columns))
    for (page in seq_along(component_pages)) {
      indices <- component_pages[[page]]
      headings <- if (kind == "joint") c("Theorem 1", "Theorem 2: raw", "Theorem 2: debiased")[indices] else paste("Component", indices)
      caption <- paste(kind, label, paste0("n = ", group_main_n), paste0("page ", page), sep = "; ")
      if (kind == "theorem2") caption <- paste(caption, "Raw (gray) and debiased (blue).")
      draw <- function() {
        g <- start_grid(length(models), length(indices), headings, unname(model_names[models]),
                        xlab = if (kind == "joint") paste0("Chi-square quantiles (df: ", paste(spec$df[indices], collapse = ", "), ")") else "Standard normal quantiles",
                        legend_labels = if (kind == "theorem2") c("Raw", "Debiased") else NULL)
        for (r in seq_along(models)) for (j in seq_along(indices)) {
          index <- indices[j]; cols <- spec$columns[index]
          if (kind == "theorem2") cols <- c(paste0("raw_lambda_", index), cols)
          df <- if (is.null(spec$df)) NULL else spec$df[index]
          colors <- if (kind == "theorem2") c(raw_gray, blue) else if (kind == "joint" && index == 2L) raw_gray else blue
          qq_panel(g, r, j, get_case(collection, models[r], group_main_n),
                   qq_limits(collection, models[r], cols, df), cols, df, colors)
        }
        finish_grid(g)
      }
      save_figure(paste(prefix, kind, paste0("n", group_main_n), paste0("page", page), sep = "_"),
                  caption, draw, length(models), length(indices))
    }
  }
  if (length(ns) > 1L) for (kind in names(specs)) {
    spec <- specs[[kind]]
    # Joint sample-size comparisons include Theorems 1 and 2 after correction.
    indices <- if (kind == "joint") c(1L, 3L) else seq_along(spec$columns)
    n_pages <- pages(ns)
    for (index in indices) for (page in seq_along(n_pages)) {
      shown_n <- n_pages[[page]]; column <- spec$columns[index]
      df <- if (is.null(spec$df)) NULL else spec$df[index]
      caption <- paste("Sample-size comparison", label, column, paste0("page ", page), sep = "; ")
      draw <- function() {
        g <- start_grid(length(models), length(shown_n), paste0("n = ", shown_n),
                        unname(model_names[models]),
                        xlab = if (is.null(df)) "Standard normal quantiles" else paste0("Chi-square quantiles (df = ", df, ")"))
        for (r in seq_along(models)) for (j in seq_along(shown_n)) {
          qq_panel(g, r, j, get_case(collection, models[r], shown_n[j]),
                   qq_limits(collection, models[r], column, df), column, df)
        }
        finish_grid(g)
      }
      save_figure(paste(prefix, "sizes", column, paste0("page", page), sep = "_"),
                  caption, draw, length(models), length(shown_n))
    }
  }
}
```

## 4. Optional all-node diagnostics

Each box summarizes **nodes**, separately for one component: the nodewise mean
or sample variance is calculated across the saved replications before the box
is drawn. The native summary stores a standard deviation, so the variance is
its square. A dot represents one node; slight deterministic horizontal offsets
make overlapping dots visible. Nodes share simulated networks and are not
independent observations. Reference lines are 0 for the mean and 1 for variance.

The heatmaps retain each node's index. They display means, variances, and marginal
95% coverage, with colors centered at 0, 1, and 0.95. Coverage is read from the
summary rather than inferred from the mean and variance. All nodes are required;
unavailable node summaries cause an error instead of quietly disappearing.
Unlike the nodewise QQ selection, the native all-node summaries require all
planned replications for every node. Incomplete all-node summaries are rejected.

```{r all-node-data, results='asis'}
all_nodes <- NULL
if (is.null(params$all_nodes_file)) {
  cat("All-node plots are skipped because `all_nodes_file` is null.\n")
} else {
  requested <- as.character(unlist(params$all_nodes_file))
  node_paths <- unique(unlist(lapply(requested, function(path) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing all-node input: ", path)
    if (!dir.exists(path)) return(path)
    found <- list.files(path, "^component_summary[.]csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    paired <- file.exists(file.path(dirname(found), "config.rds"))
    # Native runs also contain an aggregate summary above the per-case folders.
    # Use the per-case copies with their own configurations, without duplicates.
    for (aggregate in found[!paired]) {
      has_children <- any(startsWith(found[paired], paste0(dirname(aggregate), "/")))
      if (!has_children) stop("Missing config.rds beside all-node summary: ", aggregate)
      message("Using per-case summaries instead of aggregate: ", aggregate)
    }
    found[paired]
  })))
  if (!length(node_paths)) stop("No component_summary.csv files found.")
  node_inputs <- lapply(sort(node_paths), function(path) {
    cfg <- read_config(file.path(dirname(path), "config.rds"))
    d <- read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)
    need <- c("model", "n", "k", "node", "component", "design_seed", "lambda_label",
              "total_reps", "valid_reps", "invalid_reps", "complete", "mean", "sd", "marginal_coverage")
    if (!all(need %in% names(d))) stop("Missing all-node summary columns: ", path)
    expected_label <- paste0("(", paste(format(cfg$lambda_vec, trim = TRUE, digits = 10), collapse = ", "), ")")
    if (!all(model_name(d$model) == cfg$model & d$n == cfg$n & d$k == cfg$k &
             d$design_seed == cfg$design_seed) ||
        !all(gsub(" ", "", d$lambda_label) == gsub(" ", "", expected_label)))
      stop("All-node summary disagrees with its configuration: ", path)
    if (nrow(d) != cfg$n * cfg$k ||
        !setequal(paste(d$node, d$component), as.vector(outer(seq_len(cfg$n), seq_len(cfg$k), paste))) ||
        anyDuplicated(paste(d$node, d$component)))
      stop("Each node/component must occur exactly once: ", path)
    values <- as.matrix(d[c("mean", "sd", "marginal_coverage", "total_reps", "valid_reps", "invalid_reps")])
    if (anyNA(d$complete) || !all(d$complete %in% TRUE) ||
        anyNA(d[c("total_reps", "valid_reps", "invalid_reps")]) ||
        any(d$total_reps != cfg$n_sim | d$valid_reps != cfg$n_sim | d$invalid_reps != 0L))
      stop("All-node plots require every planned replication at every node; incomplete summaries found in ", path)
    if (!is.numeric(values) || any(!is.finite(values)) || any(d$valid_reps < 2L) ||
        any(d$total_reps < d$valid_reps | d$invalid_reps != d$total_reps - d$valid_reps) ||
        any(d$sd < 0 | d$marginal_coverage < 0 | d$marginal_coverage > 1))
      stop("Invalid or unavailable all-node summaries: ", path)
    d$model <- cfg$model; d$variance <- d$sd^2
    d$group <- group_key(cfg); d$lambda <- lambda_label(cfg$lambda_vec)
    list(config = cfg, data = d, path = normalizePath(path))
  })
  if (!is.null(params$sample_sizes)) node_inputs <- Filter(function(x) x$config$n %in% sample_sizes, node_inputs)
  if (!length(node_inputs)) stop("No all-node summaries match sample_sizes.")
  if (anyDuplicated(vapply(node_inputs, function(x) case_key(x$config), character(1))))
    stop("Duplicate all-node cases. Select one run or explicitly selected summary files.")
  if (any(vapply(node_inputs, function(x) design_key(x$config), character(1)) != design_key(cases[[1]]$config)))
    stop("All-node and nodewise results have incompatible seeds, target nodes, or truth designs.")
  all_nodes <- do.call(rbind, lapply(node_inputs, `[[`, "data"))
  all_node_log <- do.call(rbind, lapply(node_inputs, function(x) data.frame(
    model = x$config$model, n = x$config$n, K = x$config$k, lambda = lambda_key(x$config$lambda_vec),
    nodes = length(unique(x$data$node)), min_valid = min(x$data$valid_reps),
    max_valid = max(x$data$valid_reps), max_invalid = max(x$data$invalid_reps), csv = x$path)))
  write.csv(all_node_log, file.path(figure_dir, "all_node_inputs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    ids <- sprintf("A%02d", seq_len(nrow(all_node_log)))
    cat("All-node case IDs follow the row order in `all_node_inputs.csv`. Each summary passed the complete-replication check.\n\n")
    metadata <- data.frame(Case = ids, Model = unname(model_names[all_node_log$model]),
                           n = all_node_log$n, K = all_node_log$K,
                           Lambda = vapply(node_inputs, function(x) sub("^Lambda = ", "", lambda_label(x$config$lambda_vec)), character(1)))
    report_table(metadata, "All-node cases", align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "p{0.32\\linewidth}"), new_page = TRUE)
    counts <- data.frame(Case = ids, Nodes = all_node_log$nodes,
                         `Min. valid` = all_node_log$min_valid,
                         `Max. valid` = all_node_log$max_valid,
                         `Max. invalid` = all_node_log$max_invalid, check.names = FALSE)
    report_table(counts, "All-node replication counts", new_page = TRUE)
  } else {
    report_table(all_node_log[setdiff(names(all_node_log), "csv")])
  }
}
```

```{r all-node-figures, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(all_nodes)) {
  node_groups <- split(all_nodes, all_nodes$group)
  for (group_id in seq_along(node_groups)) {
    d <- node_groups[[group_id]]
    models <- names(model_names)[names(model_names) %in% d$model]
    ns <- sort(unique(d$n)); K <- unique(d$k)
    label <- unique(d$lambda)
    model_pages <- pages(models)
    for (component in seq_len(K)) for (page in seq_along(model_pages)) {
      shown_models <- model_pages[[page]]
      draw <- function() {
        g <- start_grid(2L, length(shown_models), unname(model_names[shown_models]),
                        c("Mean", "Variance"), xlab = "Number of nodes", ylab = "")
        for (row in 1:2) for (col in seq_along(shown_models)) {
          metric <- c("mean", "variance")[row]; ref <- c(0, 1)[row]
          open_panel(g, row, col)
          ylim <- safe_range(c(d[[metric]][d$component == component], ref))
          plot.window(c(0.55, length(ns) + 0.45), ylim)
          abline(h = ref, lty = 2, col = "#7A8187", lwd = 0.7)
          for (j in seq_along(ns)) {
            z <- d[d$model == shown_models[col] & d$n == ns[j] & d$component == component, ]
            if (!nrow(z)) next
            offset <- 0.30 * (((z$node * ((sqrt(5) - 1) / 2)) %% 1) - 0.5)
            points(j + offset, z[[metric]], pch = 16, cex = 0.24, col = adjustcolor(blue, 0.35))
            boxplot(z[[metric]], at = j, add = TRUE, axes = FALSE, outline = FALSE,
                    boxwex = 0.49, col = NA, border = ink, lwd = 0.7, whisklty = 1)
          }
          axis(1, at = seq_along(ns), labels = ns, cex.axis = 0.76, mgp = c(0, 0.3, 0), tck = -0.03)
          axis(2, cex.axis = 0.76, mgp = c(0, 0.3, 0), tck = -0.03)
          box(col = "#B2B8BC", lwd = 0.5)
        }
        finish_grid(g)
      }
      save_figure(sprintf("allnodes_group_%02d_component%d_page%d", group_id, component, page),
                  paste("All nodes", label, paste("component", component), sep = "; "), draw, 2L, length(shown_models))
    }
    # Heatmaps show the largest available n in this optional all-node group.
    map_n <- max(ns); map_data <- d[d$n == map_n, ]
    rows <- unique(map_data[c("model", "component")])
    rows <- rows[order(match(rows$model, names(model_names)), rows$component), ]
    row_pages <- split(seq_len(nrow(rows)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(rows)) / 12L))
    metrics <- c("mean", "variance", "marginal_coverage")
    centers <- c(mean = 0, variance = 1, marginal_coverage = 0.95)
    titles <- c(mean = "Mean", variance = "Variance", marginal_coverage = "Marginal 95% coverage")
    palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#216A95", "#A8CDE0", "#FAFAF7", "#EFC8A3", "#B85E24"))(201L)
    for (page in seq_along(row_pages)) {
      shown_rows <- rows[row_pages[[page]], , drop = FALSE]
      draw <- function() {
        layout(matrix(seq_len(6L), nrow = 3L, byrow = TRUE), widths = c(12, 1))
        for (metric in metrics) {
          values <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(shown_rows)), function(j) {
            z <- map_data[map_data$model == shown_rows$model[j] & map_data$component == shown_rows$component[j], ]
            z[[metric]][order(z$node)]
          }, numeric(map_n))
          dev <- max(1e-6, abs(map_data[[metric]] - centers[[metric]]))
          lim <- centers[[metric]] + c(-dev, dev)
          nr <- nrow(shown_rows)
          par(mar = c(2.4, 7.1, 2.3, 0.3), mgp = c(1.3, 0.3, 0), las = 1)
          image(seq_len(map_n), seq_len(nr), values[, rev(seq_len(nr)), drop = FALSE],
                col = palette, zlim = lim, xlim = c(0.5, map_n + 0.5), ylim = c(0.5, nr + 0.5),
                axes = FALSE, xlab = "Node index", ylab = "", useRaster = FALSE)
          axis(1, at = unique(c(1L, round(map_n * (1:4) / 4))), cex.axis = 0.8)
          axis(2, at = seq_len(nr), labels = rev(paste(model_names[shown_rows$model], shown_rows$component, sep = " / ")),
               tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.8)
          title(main = titles[[metric]], adj = 0, cex.main = 1)
          box(col = "#B2B8BC", lwd = 0.5)
          par(mar = c(2.4, 0.1, 2.3, 3.4), mgp = c(1.3, 0.3, 0), las = 1)
          ticks <- seq(lim[1], lim[2], length.out = 201L)
          image(1, ticks, matrix(ticks, nrow = 1L), col = palette, zlim = lim, axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
          at <- c(lim[1], centers[[metric]], lim[2])
          axis(4, at = at, labels = formatC(at, format = "f", digits = 3), cex.axis = 0.70)
          box(col = "#B2B8BC", lwd = 0.5)
        }
      }
      save_figure(sprintf("allnodes_group_%02d_map_n%d_page%d", group_id, map_n, page),
                  paste("All nodes", label, paste0("n = ", map_n), paste("page", page), sep = "; "),
                  draw, 3L, 1L, width = 8.0, height = max(6.0, 2.8 + 0.60 * nrow(shown_rows)))
    }
  }
}
```

## 5. Output files

Each displayed figure is saved as PDF and PNG in `output_dir`. The HTML embeds
PNG previews; the PDF report embeds the vector PDF files, with one figure per page.
`figure_manifest.csv` maps filenames to their settings;
`plot_inputs.csv` and `row_selection.csv` document exactly which results were
used. `all_node_inputs.csv` is added when optional all-node summaries are read.
Repeated knitting replaces matching filenames. Use a new output directory when
the input collection changes, so files from an earlier run are not mistaken for
current results.

```{r output-manifest, results='asis'}
if (length(figure_manifest)) {
  figure_manifest_table <- do.call(rbind, figure_manifest)
  write.csv(figure_manifest_table, file.path(figure_dir, "figure_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    cat("Figure numbers below follow the report and the row order in `figure_manifest.csv`. Full PDF/PNG filenames are recorded in the CSV.\n\n")
    report_table(data.frame(Figure = seq_len(nrow(figure_manifest_table)),
                            Description = figure_manifest_table$description),
                 "Figure index", align = c("r", "p{0.82\\linewidth}"))
  } else {
    report_table(figure_manifest_table)
  }
}
```
